bio.text: Jerrad Christian is a candidate for Ohio's 12th Congressional District, according to his campaign website, "Christian for OH-12."

According to his campaign website, he grew up in the Appalachian region of Ohio and served five years in the U.S. Navy, first as a flight deck fueler on an aircraft carrier and then as a meteorologist and oceanographer.
The site says he used GI Bill funds to attend Ohio University, worked as an outdoor education teacher, and later became a software engineer after attending a tech school.
